prompt: A promotion would bring more money and responsibility, but longer hours. You value the opportunity and the life you've built outside work.

leftCard.label: Accept
leftCard.outcome: Bigger office, bigger salary. You see your friends less.

rightCard.label: Decline
rightCard.outcome: You stay where you are, and you're home for dinner every night.

prompt: You've found a home that feels right, but the mortgage would leave little room for surprises. Renting keeps you flexible, though the rent keeps rising.

leftCard.label: Buy it
leftCard.outcome: The mortgage is terrifying. The garden is perfect.

rightCard.label: Keep renting
rightCard.outcome: Your landlord still won't fix the boiler.

prompt: A friend invites you to train for a marathon together. The goal excites you, but six months of training would claim time and energy you already use elsewhere.

leftCard.label: Train for it
leftCard.outcome: You finish, limping, in four hours fifty. You cry at the finish line.

rightCard.label: Back out
rightCard.outcome: You cheer them on from mile 20 with a bacon sandwich.

prompt: An old school friend is in town this weekend. You remember good times, but you've both changed, and reconnecting takes effort you may not have right now.

leftCard.label: Meet up
leftCard.outcome: Within ten minutes it's like you never left school.

rightCard.label: Leave it on read
rightCard.outcome: You meant to reply. A year goes by.

prompt: Your doctor is concerned about your stress and recommends time off. Work is demanding, and stepping away could help—but you worry about the consequences of being absent.

leftCard.label: Take the time
leftCard.outcome: Two weeks of nothing. You remember who you are.

rightCard.label: Push through
rightCard.outcome: You hit your targets. Your hands won't stop shaking.

prompt: You keep returning to the sports car listings. Buying one would use savings you worked hard to build, but wanting it isn't only about practicality.

leftCard.label: Buy one
leftCard.outcome: It's impractical and loud, and you grin every time you start it.

rightCard.label: Get a grip
rightCard.outcome: You buy a sensible hatchback. It's very reliable.

prompt: Since her fall, your mum needs daily help and wants to remain independent. Your work and home can't easily absorb everything she needs; the family must decide what care can look like.

leftCard.label: Move her in
leftCard.outcome: It's crowded and hard, and you wouldn't change it.

rightCard.label: Find a care home
rightCard.outcome: She's well looked after. You visit on Sundays.

prompt: Teaching has stayed with you as a possibility. Retraining would mean lower income and years of effort, while staying offers security but may leave the question unanswered.

leftCard.label: Retrain
leftCard.outcome: A classroom of thirty teenagers. You've found your thing.

rightCard.label: Stay put
rightCard.outcome: You're good at your job. You just don't love it.

prompt: At a check-up, your doctor suggests cutting back on alcohol. Drinking is part of how you unwind and socialise, but you've started wondering what it costs you.

leftCard.label: Go sober
leftCard.outcome: You sleep better. The pub quiz team misses you.
